title: Bank of Baroda pays $600 million to settle NMC Health fraud litigation in Abu Dhabi, London
description: Bank of Baroda has agreed to an out-of-court settlement of US$600 million (approximately ₹5,700 crore) to resolve high-stakes litigation with the NMC Health group and its joint administrators in Abu Dhabi and London.The state-owned lender resolved insolvency proceedings in Abu Dhabi and London without admitting liability, capping its exposure in the NMC Health collapse at $600 million (₹5,700 crore).The same was were disclosed by the bank in a regulatory filing on July 2. The payment, settl
